wiki.title: Bill Roemer
wiki.extract: William "Bill" Roemer (born August 21, 1956) is a member of the Ohio House of Representatives, since 2019, representing the 31st district. The district encompasses the majority of western and northern Summit county. A Republican, he is serving his fourth term in the House of Representatives. In 2026, he considered a run for the Ohio Senate but declined to enter the race, citing family reasons.
